sources.title: Doc 301 — General Conditions of the Contract (Philippine Construction)
sources.reference: Doc 301, Standard General Conditions of the Contract for Public Works
sources.notes: The entire article expounds on contractor obligations under Doc 301 including scope compliance, quality standards, bonds, and the one-year guarantee period.

sources.title: Civil Code of the Philippines — Article 1723
sources.reference: Civil Code of the Philippines, Art. 1723
sources.notes: Article 1723 extends contractor liability beyond the one-year guarantee to 10 years (poor materials/construction) or 15 years (defects in the ground) for total or partial demolition, creating solidary liability with the architect/engineer.
